statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
There is concern for underlying sick sinus syndrome
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is to correlate symptomatic episodes with specific arrhythmic events
The service is to assess the frequency of bradyarrhythmias
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
The service is not separately payable under current policy guidelines
